title: I'm making my dream space strategy game...
author: BlackwatchCommand
selftext:
I’ve wanted to make a big sci-fi fleet RTS for as long as I can remember, so I finally started building it on my own. It’s called Blackwatch Command.

![video](sx9l5baptjxh1 "All footage was captured in game with UI removed.")

The idea is simple, you give the orders, and your forces work out how to make it happen. No need for intense micro management!

The first pre-alpha prototype is a 3-map skirmish I made to test the ships and see how they counter each other. It’s early and very rough.

What I’d love from you:

* What do you want most from a fleet RTS that you rarely get?
* Anything that looks confusing or off in the footage?
